final: WITH timing_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(timing_avg) AS mean_ownership, AVG(timing_avg - overall_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM timing_avgs CROSS JOIN overall WHERE timing_avg > overall_avg
